altText: A male American Goldfinch in summer: brilliant lemon yellow with a black cap and black wings, perched on goldenrod.
A bright yellow male American Goldfinch clinging sideways to a dried seed head.
A female American Goldfinch, drab olive-buff rather than yellow, on grass seed heads — with the same black wings and white wing bars the male has.
A dull olive female American Goldfinch clinging to an upright stem.
